title: Per-network market index
description: Reduced, flattened output for one network: <network>.json

corridor.description: The rail a market side settles on. Absent means "arkade" (every spot market). EVM rails are named per chain — see the card schema's corridor definition for why one blanket "evm" value would give the same token on two chains the same leg key.

id.description: Canonical asset identity: "btc", "native" for a chain corridor's own coin (ETH on ethereum), a 68-hex-char AssetId, or a lowercase 0x-prefixed contract address. The id is not chain-qualified by itself — the side's corridor names the chain and the leg key is "<corridor>:<id>", so one address on two chains is two markets, and "native" means a different coin on each chain. Lowercase rather than EIP-55 mixed case so the identity is byte-comparable; the checksum belongs to display, not to a grouping key. A bare name vs an address is also what tells a taker WHICH SETTLEMENT path a corridor uses, so the token standard need not be named separately: "native" settles as a plain value transfer of the chain's own coin (Boltz's EtherSwap), a 0x address settles through that token's contract (ERC20Swap). The 0x address is the TOKEN's address, never the swap contract's — a taker resolves the latter from the corridor, not from this field.

type.description: The price feed response is JSON.

price_path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the numeric feed value, e.g. /price or /bitcoin/usd. Empty string selects the whole JSON document.

amount.description: A canonical decimal-string amount of atomic units: unsigned, no leading zeros. "0" disables the side it bounds.

enabledAmount.description: An amount that is strictly positive: the side it bounds is enabled.

pair.description: Display pair "<base-label>/<quote-label>", where a side's label is its ticker on the arkade corridor and "<corridor>:<ticker>" otherwise. Canonical identity is the corridor-qualified leg pair.

transports.description: The solver card's v0 transport map, propagated by the reducer when present. Nostr is the only supported protocol key.

price_feed.description: Present on cross-asset markets only; absent on same-asset corridor markets, whose price is identically 1.

price_decimals.description: The feed value divided by 10^price_decimals is the price in quote-atomic-units per base-atomic-unit.

fee_flat.description: The part of the price that does not scale with size, in quote-asset atomic units. OPTIONAL; absent means none. Carried through from the solver's card unchanged.

min_base_amount.description: Lower trade-size bound for the base side, in base atomic units. An enabled side has 1 <= min <= max; when the side is disabled (max = "0") min MUST be "0".

max_base_amount.description: Upper trade-size bound for the base side, in base atomic units. "0" disables the side: the solver does not pay out base and makers cannot receive it.

min_quote_amount.description: Lower trade-size bound for the quote side, in quote atomic units. An enabled side has 1 <= min <= max; when the side is disabled (max = "0") min MUST be "0".

max_quote_amount.description: Upper trade-size bound for the quote side, in quote atomic units. "0" disables the side: the solver does not pay out quote and makers cannot receive it.
